description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called TagsPage that provides a UI for listing, creating, editing, and deleting tags within the app. It interacts with repositories for tags and tasks, uses navigation to transition between pages, and includes user interaction elements such as dialogs and snackbars.

classes.name: TagsPage
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays and manages a list of tags, allowing creation, editing, and deletion via a user interface.

methods.name: _openCreate
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage to create a new tag.

methods.name: _openEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the TagFormPage with a given tag for editing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the tags page, including list of tags, loading states, and action buttons.

methods.name: _showTagMenu
methods.description: Displays a modal bottom sheet with options to edit or delete a tag.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog and processes the deletion of a tag along with associated task updates.
